# `ip.arrange`

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from crates/ew-commands/schemas/ip.arrange.schema.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

`ip.arrange` (`ArrangeIps`, FR-XRF-013, WP-S2.04 §5.1, D12): interruption points of one page exchanged into a new
order.

- `ips` are IP functions in the new order: at least two, none twice, each with exactly one representation, all
  on one page. The slots are the current positions of their representations sorted by `(y, x)` (ties by the
  representation ID); slot `i` goes to `ips[i]` (its representation's `pos`; orientation, symbol and type kept).
- Routes of the connections on that page at the moved IPs' CPs follow each CP's displacement
  (`geometry::follow_end`).
- With `set_sort`, the `sort` of `ips[i]` becomes `i + 1` (the chain order).

The order is the caller's (the tool sorts by name or by the derived potential name): nothing derived is read
inside the transaction (the transaction-read rule, ID-525). Rejected: fewer than two IPs; an IP listed twice; a
function that is not an interruption point or that has not exactly one representation; representations on
different pages; a missing function. Interactive. Outcome: none.

## Types

### CmdUuid

A lower-case hyphenated UUID naming a record (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 36 character(s), at most 36 character(s))

Pattern: `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`

## Exit codes

A command runs as one line of a command log replayed by `ew apply` ([doc 17 §3.5](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#35-command-logs-ewcmd)). The exit code of `ew apply` is:

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | The line committed as one transaction. |
| 1 | A prevent rule or the command's own domain rule refused the line (`Prevented`, `Rejected`); without `--one-step` the lines before it stay committed and are saved, with `--one-step` nothing is saved. |
| 2 | Anything else stops the replay: invalid parameters, a missing record, an unresolvable reference, an open, lock or save error. |

The codes of every subcommand are in [doc 17 §3.2](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#32-exit-codes).
